notes: variable(context, name, value): by default all variables go into one Variable Studio (3 calls total); FSGEN_VARIABLES=tree makes Variable features in the tree (1 call each).
Offset plane: entities = a plane/face, offset = distance (cplaneType is sent automatically).
patternType FEATURE + instanceFunction [feature ids]; axis can be a construction line.
A REMOVE extrude pointing away from the part finishes with INFO and cuts nothing; check the sketch normal.
Set defaultScope false + booleanScope to the part for ADD/REMOVE.
Select edges geometrically: qParallelEdges(edges, vector), qContainsPoint(edges, point on edge).

linearPattern.learnedFrom: Fan adapter: a 100 x 60 x 3 mm base plate with a row of 6 vent slots (4 mm wide, 40 mm long, 12 mm apart, rounded ends) on the left half, and on the right half a solid loft rising from a 40 x 40 mm square on the plate top to a 30 mm diameter circle 25 mm above the plate. Four 3.4 mm mounting holes, 5 mm from each corner.

notes: patternType FEATURE + instanceFunction; mirrorPlane = a default plane face.
Default planes: Top/Front/Right; constraints and dimensions are generated automatically.
Axis: a construction line in the profile sketch via sketchEntityQuery(id + "Sketch", EntityType.EDGE, "axis").
Positive thickness hollows inward; entities = faces to remove.
